goal: Prevent unauthorized clients from tying up all HTTP RPC worker threads with invalid credentials
Stop denial of service against legitimate authenticated RPC callers
reviewability: Author moved the PR to draft to consider an alternative dedicated slow-reply thread design
agreement: Support because the worker exhaustion vector is cheap and easy to hit (willcl-ark)
Resolved objection: removing the sleep speeds up password guessing, but DoS risk is worse (willcl-ark)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an easy resource exhaustion denial-of-service vector on the HTTP server
Prevents unauthenticated clients with network access from blocking legitimate RPC calls
